import subprocess, sys, textwrap, pathlib, tempfile
spec = textwrap.dedent('''
    SPEC = {"canvas": {"width": 1280, "height": 720},
            "theme": {"colors": {"background": "#FFFFFF", "ink": "#111111",
                                 "muted": "#777777", "primary": "#222222",
                                 "secondary": "#333333", "accent": "#AA0000"},
                      "fonts": {"cn": "Source Han Sans SC", "latin": "Arial"}},
            "slides": [{"id": "s01",
                        "source_zone": {"x": 48, "y": 664, "width": 1184, "height": 40},
                        "page_intent": {"insight": "A", "focus": "t"},
                        "elements": [{"type": "text", "id": "t", "x": 400, "y": 300,
                                      "width": 480, "height": 120, "size": 48, "text": "A",
                                      "color": "ink", "max_lines": 1, "line_height": 1.2}]}]}
''')
d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(d / "build_probe.py").write_text(spec, encoding="utf-8")
code = (
    "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')\n"
    "from vao import run_check\n"
    f"run_check(r'{d / 'build_probe.py'}', r'{d / 'spec.pptx'}', mode='spec',\n"
    "          json_output=True)\n"
    "bad = sorted({n for n in sys.modules if n.split('.')[0] in "
    "{'pptx','lxml','compiler'}})\n"
    "print('FORBIDDEN MODULES:', bad)\n"
    "assert not bad, bad\n"
)
out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(out.stdout, out.stderr)
sys.exit(out.returncode)
PY
